# bd-wn8xh — documented CLI surfaces that no executed test or e2e script invokes.
#
# `surfaces.implemented` counts a surface as covered when it appears in the CLI
# parser. This file records the surfaces that pass THAT bar and still have no
# behavioral evidence behind them: they parse, and nothing runs them.
#
# THIS LIST MAY ONLY SHRINK. scripts/vision-coverage.sh fails in both
# directions: a documented surface that is newly unexercised and absent from
# this file is an error, and an entry here that has since acquired an
# invocation is ALSO an error telling you to delete the line. One arm without
# the other is how a baseline decays into a permanent ignore-list.
#
# To retire an entry: add a test or e2e script that actually invokes the
# surface, then remove its line. Do not remove a line to quiet the gate --
# the stale arm exists precisely so that a removal without an invocation
# fails louder than leaving it.
#
# WHY A NAMED LIST AND NOT A PERCENTAGE: the behavioral gap on this tree is
# 4.96%, four hundredths under the 5% cadence threshold AGENTS.md publishes,
# and it moved from 7.09% to 4.96% purely by teaching the detector about
# helper-mediated invocations. A number that close to its own threshold, and
# that mobile under ordinary detector changes, must not be the thing that
# decides whether main is red for every agent. Each line below is checkable on
# its own; a percentage is not.
#
# Recorded 2026-09-17. Every entry was hand-verified by enumerating spellings
# (quoted-pair, shell invocation, and helper-mediated), not by trusting the
# detector's own absence -- the detector's blind spots are the reason this file
# needs hand verification at all.

# No invocation of any kind anywhere in tests/ or scripts/. Zero lines mention
# both words outside comments. These four are the clearest real gaps in the set.
focus add
focus explain
focus remove
focus show

# `ee workflow create`: the only hits pairing "workflow" with "create" are
# unrelated (`gh release create` in tests/install_workflows.rs, and prose about
# shell startup files). Nothing invokes the surface.
workflow create

# `ee diag contention`: scripts/e2e_diag_contention.sh does exercise it, but
# that script is itself an orphan -- it is listed in
# tests/fixtures/e2e_invocation/orphan_baseline.txt, wired into no runner, and
# therefore never executed. The only other hit is a string equality in
# tests/contracts/contention_schema.rs (`== Some("diag contention")`), which
# compares a name rather than running a command. A suite nothing runs is not
# evidence; retiring this entry means wiring that script, which is bd-udjrq's
# remaining work.
diag contention

# `ee import eidetic-legacy`: appears only inside an effect-contract name list
# (tests/effect_contracts.rs, `for command in ["import cass", "import jsonl",
# "import eidetic-legacy"]`). That asserts the command's declared effect, not
# its behavior -- it is parser presence one layer removed, which is the exact
# bar this term declines to accept.
import eidetic-legacy
